items.description: Locate leak and open bathroom wall
items.rationale: The indoor supply-pipe fracture is insured under §1.1, and §2.1 covers locating the leak and opening the wall. Two hours at about €97 gross per hour, benchmarked to the leak-detection technician in Case 34, totals €194.

items.description: Replace split 15 mm copper pipe section and fittings
items.rationale: Section 2.2 covers like-for-like replacement of the fractured section. Allow €295 gross for labour and fittings, close to the localised copper repair in Case 34, with wall access billed separately.

items.description: Close, re-plaster and re-tile 0.2 m² wall patch
items.rationale: Sections 2.1 and 2.3 cover closing the opening and restoring the plaster and tiles to their previous condition. Allow €230 gross for labour and materials on the small patch only, without retiling the undamaged bathroom.

Section 3.1 expressly excludes servicing and descaling even during the same visit, and the boiler work was unrelated to the leak. The €200 gross figure is a conditional price estimate only, not a payable allowance.
